contracts.element: Mandatory decision blockers and confirm gate
contracts.note: The gate lists secrets, targets, role, drunk, given and redirect. Unit tests cover the pure stepBlockers order; stepContext's needsGiven branch has no unit oracle and a mutation to false survives the unit suite (see M-07).
Target, applied, death, scheduled, prevented and revived are distinguished from events and future effects.
A localized error.N wins; the engine sentence is a fallback. The state stays unchanged.

skipStep marks any step done/skipped and does not require optional. The Po's resolver's record-no-one is bypassed, so a skipped Po step does not set poNoOne and the next Po step is not three targets. Probe: a mandatory Imp step is skipped with ok:true and no death.
contracts.validation: skipStep checks phase/step.done only; optional is not read.

contracts.note: The preview identity is pinned; the engine remains the authority.
Only living Minions are offered; the engine rechecks.
Spy good and Recluse evil are exposed; the engine rejects an irrelevant registration. Setup pairs cover the Spy/Recluse character queries.

contracts.element: Given answer select for false information/registration
contracts.note: givens are keyed by draftKey and are not dropped when the target changes; a chosen answer for target A remains for target B. The engine validates the answer against the new info and may reject, but the card/step can display the old answer.
contracts.action: Choose an answer; then change the target.

contracts.note: For an impaired actor the StepCard renders the template branch; the show-template button is disabled unless infoTemplate is non-empty. A selected given answer alone cannot open the card, although shownCardText would prefer it. Typing a template only to enable the button makes the card show the given answer, not the template. The OpenSpec scenario 'Poisoned Chef with a chosen number' is unreachable.
contracts.validation: The card reads derived.info + givens + template.

contracts.note: infoTemplate is one string in useTableDrafts, not keyed by draftKey; closeOverlay and clearStep do not clear it. A template typed for one impaired step can appear on the next step's card.

contracts.note: The overlay is a host reference; the impaired Spy warning does not replace the real grimoire with a computed false one.

contracts.validation: BMR step min/max = real Minion count.

contracts.note: Death marks, role choices, drunk recipient, poison neighbour and resurrect are host controls; the engine validates the step outcome.

contracts.element: SnV outcome controls and death choices
contracts.note: The night step covers Barber/Sweetheart/Cerenovus. A Klutz executed during the day has no day control: recordKlutzChoice is never called from src/ui. A Witch curse from a day nomination has no control: the nominate command is unreachable from the UI. The correction dialog cannot deactivate the curse effect or change a shown role.
contracts.validation: Engine commands exist; no UI caller.

contracts.note: The dock shows done/total. QueuePanel is implemented but imported nowhere (UNREACHABLE UI-084).

contracts.element: Execution target select and execute action
contracts.note: The engine accepts a dead target (States r1039: dead players may be executed again) and records the day's one execution with no death. The UI lists dead players with an 'already dead' suffix. The OpenSpec day-and-win requirement that requires error.55 contradicts the pin; see F-013.
contracts.validation: executeByDecision phase/day/one-execution checks; no living-target check.

contracts.note: DayCard offers the checkbox for any script containing pacifist/sailor/fool/devilsadvocate/zombuul; Dock offers it for a living Pacifist and a good target (no impairment check). Both send survives: drafts.executeSurvives. The engine accepts only a good target with a living, unimpaired Pacifist; otherwise error.57. Probe: a BMR 6 Fool bag with no Pacifist returns error.57. The checkbox also persists across days (UI-049).

contracts.element: Stale execution target and survives flag across days
contracts.note: executeTarget/executeSurvives are single values. TableScreen clears the target only when createdAt changes. DayCard is keyed by day, but the parent drafts keep the old target and toggle; the dock can execute the previous day's target or carry a stale survives flag. The engine may reject (survives) or accept (target).
Dawn names the night deaths and the survivor count; the execution result names the player and whether a death occurred.

contracts.element: Seat vote count and dead vote controls
contracts.note: The UI follows registersAlive: a registered-dead living Zombuul is shown as dead for voting, with ghost-vote/dead-vote controls. The engine day path still counts player.alive in recordVotes/nominate, so the displayed dead-vote state and the engine ledger disagree. Root cause and tests are the existing engine finding #313; this contract is its UI regression surface, not a separate UI defect.
contracts.action: Record a count; spend/restore a dead vote.

badges are acting, nominated, scheduled, dead, registered-dead, ghost/no-ghost, drunk, poison, protection. A player with both a drunk and a poison effect shows only drunk because seatProjection.poisoned is suppressed and seatBadges uses else-if (F-010). The registered-dead ghost-vote display follows registersAlive and is correct per the intended rule; the engine vote path is tracked by #313.
The bag and secrets screens render the derived support level; a host-choice/unsupported row weakens the role.
Play/setup/reference groups; public screen hides the menu; unknown route falls back.

One undo control in the dock; undo replays the journal and persists the replayed state.

Key/parameter parity passes, and engine error/note keys resolve. The role-catalog abilities are outside these tests: RU Juggler loses 'your first day', RU Tinker loses 'at any time', AZ Godfather loses 'Outsider', AZ Exorcist omits the Exorcist token; the RU Empath count is asserted by the F-015 data test. Hardcoded copy in dialogs/seat/sheet bypasses the catalogs.

contracts.note: publicSnapshot and publicGameView implement the same public projection; the UI uses publicGameView. The deepEqual contract test keeps them aligned, but a second implementation is a drift risk.

mode='hidden' is not used by any production screen; it hardcodes the Russian 'Роль скрыта'.

Nine routes plus /sheet/{lang}; /help and /demo are legacy DOM screens; /table, /bag, /seat, /secrets, /player, /public and /sheet are native.
